actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident6 gave >30 units last round, so punish with max severity (floor(wallet/punishment_cost)). Also broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to follow Aggressive Red rules. Check last round contributions: any resident contributed >30? From round_history round1 contributions: Resident6 contributed 80.0 which is >30. So we must punish that resident with severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Our wallet is 119.75. punishment_cost 0.3, severity = floor(119.75/0.3)= floor(399.166)=399. But cannot exceed affordable? Punishment costs severity * cost = 399*0.3 =119.7 which is <= wallet 119.75, okay. So punish Resident6 with amount 399 (severity). Action punish target Resident6 amount 399. Also can broadcast a message? Rule says if punish, that's the action; can also broadcast? It says choose at most one physical and one communication. We can also broadcast discouraging large contributions. Should we? Probably yes. Provide broadcast "Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low". Explanation.
